audited_source_corrections.action: Proved the local clause from a local premise, then derived the global clause by applying it at every world.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source labels the global-satisfaction conclusion as the local clause and then tries to prove the local conclusion from the stronger global premise; this reverses the proposition's two displayed claims.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் முதலில் $w$ இல் உள்ளூர் நிறைவிலிருந்து $w$ இல் முடிவை நிறுவி, பின்னர் அந்த முடிவை ஒவ்வொரு $u\in W$ க்கும் பயன்படுத்தி உலகளாவிய நிறைவை நிறுவுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Preserving the reversed numbering and stronger premise, which would not prove the first displayed implication as stated.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The first claim is exactly the definition of semantic entailment at a world; universal application of that claim gives the second claim.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the proof use the local premise for item 1 and quantify over every world only for item 2?

audited_source_corrections.action: Called X together with its family of open sets a topological space, reserving topology for the family of open sets.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source first says X may be written for a topology and then says X becomes a topology, although the preceding definition identifies the topology with the collection of open subsets and X with the underlying set.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் $X$ ஐ அடிப்படைக் கணமாகவும், திறந்த கணங்களின் குடும்பத்தை இடவியலாகவும், இரண்டையும் சேர்த்து இடவியல் வெளி என்றும் வேறுபடுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Using topology for both the family and the underlying set, which would erase the distinction made by the definition.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Standard notation distinguishes a topology from the topological space consisting of its carrier and open-set family.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the prose distinguish the topology from the topological space X?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed both strict subset signs to non-strict subset-or-equal signs.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source uses strict inclusion for derivability and for the set-theoretic modus-ponens property, but equality is allowed in both cases; in particular A proves A.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Preserving strict inclusion, which would falsely deny reflexive derivability when the two extensions coincide.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Semantic consequence corresponds to ordinary inclusion, and the implication clause guarantees a subset relation that need not be proper.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Do both containment claims allow equality?
